description: This source file defines the 'Details' feature for handling article detail requests, including a request class, validator, and handler to retrieve an article by slug.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the request to retrieve an article by its slug.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the Query to ensure the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the retrieval of an article based on the provided slug and returns an ArticleEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to fetch an article by slug, throwing a RestException if not found.
